Coached by players, for players

Train with the players who play.

6ers Cricket Training Academy is run by three Rock Hill High School juniors, with coaches who play in local leagues like USA Cricket Dallas Hub. We offer year-round private training and match practice, plus camps during school breaks.

Who we are

Students who live the game

The 6ers was founded by three juniors at Rock Hill High School. Our coaches play in local leagues such as USA Cricket Dallas Hub, so they know what it takes to improve because they are doing it themselves, right now.

We keep sessions focused, energetic and safe, and we schedule camps around the school calendar so training never competes with class.

What we offer

Private training and break camps

Train one-on-one or in match practice all year, or join a camp when school is out. We don't run weekly group classes or skill clinics.

Year-round · $19.99

Private Training

One player, one coach, and a plan built around that player's goals.

  • Personal skill assessment
  • Batting, bowling, fielding or keeping focus
  • Flexible scheduling around school
Year-round · $19.99

Match Practice

Simulated innings and game situations to sharpen decisions under pressure.

  • Run-chase and death-over scenarios
  • Field placement and strategy
  • Book on its own or add to private training
School breaks · $17.99/day

Break Camps

Half-day camps planned for Winter Break, the Presidents' Day weekend and Spring Break.

  • Skills rotations every morning
  • Fitness and fielding games
  • Mini-match to finish
Summer · $17.99/day

Summer Camps

Week-long camps planned for June and July that build from fundamentals to match play.

  • Monday–Friday mornings
  • Friday match day
  • Progress report at week's end
